title: Monastery of the Holy Trinity, Vilnius
geometryBasis: The current named church footprint, separate belfry and mapped historic wings establish the layout. The street gate follows the mapped passage and the photographed width, columns and arch proportions.
sectionBasis: The national statutory inventory identifies the hall church, four towers, triple apses and four roof treatments. The cleared ground views show the painted west facade, stone portal, square detached belfry and the layered central street gateway.
limitations: Gate width and fine stucco ornaments are approximate. Adjoining historic ranges are represented as exterior volumes with generalized openings. Minor detached elements and the surrounding historic district are outside the boundary.
The 30-metre surface model retains canopy and rooftop returns and does not survey individual staircase or courtyard surfaces.
